title: Hoe In One
description: Fortune Hoes have a chance to replant harvested Crops (and Nether warts)
body:
Lightweight, vanilla-friendly mod that saves your back from tedious replanting.

Basically, whenever you harvest a crop using a hoe enchanted with Fortune, there's a chance it’ll just replant itself automatically. The higher your Fortune level, the better your luck: it's a **15% chance per Fortune level**

## Works with:
- Wheat
- Carrots
- Potatoes
- Beetroot
- Torch Flowers
- Netherwart
- **Modded Crops** (Assuming they implement those crops properly)

## Compatibility
- Supports Minecraft version 1.21.11 (More versions soon)
- Fabric Mod Loader
- Works both in Singleplayer and Multiplayer (Only the server needs it)
